info.title: Senlay Environmental Evidence API
info.description: Senlay provides physical-world environmental intelligence for autonomous systems, robotics and AI applications. Its evaluation beta returns available coordinate-level environmental evidence through REST and MCP, including measured/model provenance, source age, spatial relevance, conflicts and explicit unknowns. The drone domain evaluates wind evidence at one coordinate; it does not evaluate aircraft limits, route, altitude wind, visibility, precipitation, airspace or flight permission. Decision support only.

RiskAssessment.description: Aggregate deterministic SmartSurf/Senlay risk state. A null score and unknown level mean required evidence cannot support a risk score; they must never be interpreted as low risk. Decision support only; not drowning detection or certified rescue dispatch.

AssessmentState.description: Whether usable current evidence covers the groups required for the requested activity. Independent emergency signals can still produce a scored critical risk when environmental evidence is incomplete.

Outcome.description: GO: conditions within thresholds, evidence adequate. CAUTION: within thresholds but marginal, or a relevant unknown exists. NO_GO: a threshold is exceeded on adequate evidence. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the evidence does not support any of the above; see `unknowns` for what is blocking the assessment. This is a normal, successful (HTTP 200) result, never an error.

Unknown.description: One specific variable that blocked the assessment when outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

variable.description: The evidence-requirement group or comparison field that could not support a decision, e.g. "wind_gust".

resolution.description: Plainly what would resolve the gap, e.g. "A hardware observation within 15km of the requested coordinate."

reason.description: Short, human-readable justification for the label. Never a bare number.

ConfidenceComponents.description: Confidence decomposed into four independently reported components instead of one opaque scalar.

Conflict.description: A structured, named disagreement between contributing sources for one variable. Conflicts are reported, not averaged away.

ProviderCapability.description: Versioned additive provider metadata. Consumers should preserve unknown properties and treat missing fields as unknown.

WeatherEvidenceMetadata.description: Normalized weather sample provenance and time metadata; not a substitute for source values or authorization evidence.

valid_at_relation.description: Relationship of the point valid_at timestamp to response evaluation time; not a validity interval.

validity.description: Provider validity interval state; unknown when only point valid_at is available.

x-source-family-wording: 23 catalog entries; configured and returned sources vary by coordinate
x-safety-disclaimer: Senlay provides context, evidence, and decision support. It is not a safety authority. Final decisions remain with operators, users, and customer applications.
